title_lines: 8.1 Structured Venture (Private) Limited (SVPL) is a subsidiary of the company. The total amount of investment approved by the shareholders of
the Company in the extra-ordinary general meeting held on June 22, 2010 was Rs. 625 million. As of the balance sheet date, the Company has
invested a total sum of Rs. 488.581 million.
In accordance with the settlement agreement made in March 31, 2026, Structured Venture (Pvt.) Limited has received Rs. 187,500,000 and Rs.
93,750,000 on 1 April 2026 and 1 July 2026, respectively. The remaining amount of Rs. 93,750,000 was contractually due on 1 October 2026
As a result of the reassessment, the recoverable amount of the investment increased and the Company recognized a reversal of impairment
loss amounting to Rs. 93.75 million in profit or loss during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
8.2 Fair value of the investment as the year end was Rs. 46.48 per share (2026: 53.74 per share) as per quoted market price.
